chunks: And from him, from Muhammad ibn Ali, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ghiyath ibn Ibrahim, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), from his father, from Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him), who said:
Three things remove phlegm and increase retention (of knowledge): using the miswak, fasting, and recitation of the Quran.

key_terms.السِّوَاكُ: Using the miswak (tooth-stick) for oral hygiene

ai.seo_question: What are the three things that remove phlegm and increase memory according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Recorded in Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* through the chain of Imam al-Sadiq, this hadith links physical hygiene and spiritual discipline to cognitive clarity, reflecting the Shia emphasis on the unity of bodily and mental purification. The inclusion of *miswak* alongside fasting and Quranic recitation highlights the Prophetic tradition of maintaining oral purity as a prerequisite for effective worship and retention of divine knowledge.
